title: Ladybug
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <g stroke='#3a1a1a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='28' y1='52' x2='14' y2='44'/>
    <line x1='27' y1='64' x2='12' y2='64'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='76' x2='16' y2='88'/>
    <line x1='72' y1='52' x2='86' y2='44'/>
    <line x1='73' y1='64' x2='88' y2='64'/>
    <line x1='70' y1='76' x2='84' y2='88'/>
  </g>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='30' ry='28' fill='#e8352e'/>
  <!-- shine -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='50' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#ff8a80' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='15' fill='#2f2f3a'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <g stroke='#2f2f3a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'>
    <path d='M44 20 Q38 12 34 8'/>
    <path d='M56 20 Q62 12 66 8'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='34' cy='8' r='3' fill='#2f2f3a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='8' r='3' fill='#2f2f3a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='30' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='2' fill='#20202a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='31' r='2' fill='#20202a'/>
  <!-- wing split -->
  <line x1='50' y1='42' x2='50' y2='90' stroke='#2a0f0f' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='56' r='6' fill='#201018'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='56' r='6' fill='#201018'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='75' r='5' fill='#201018'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='75' r='5' fill='#201018'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='4' fill='#201018'/>
</svg>
